header.title: How to Repair a Washing Machine Lid Switch
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose and repair a faulty lid switch in a washing machine. By following these steps, you can safely replace the switch and restore your machine's functionality.

steps.description: Ensure the electrical supply is disconnected and the machine has no power.
actions: make sure the electrical supply has been disconnected
there is no power going to the machine

steps.description: This step involves removing the top of the washing machine by unscrewing and lifting it off.
actions: Unscrew the top of the washing machine.
Make note of the placement of the screws and bolts.
Work in a clockwise pattern when removing screws and bolts.
Place the screws and bolts on a surface or sectioned container in the order they are removed.
Liftoff the top of the machine.

steps.description: Remove the old lid switch and replace it with a new one, securing it with clamps or screws.
Replace the machine lid, reversing the removal process if necessary.
Refasten the lid of the machine by replacing screws and bolts.
Test the machine's functionality by plugging it in and running it through various cycles.
